name: InboxSla
description: Inbound emails by handling state and bookkeeper, with 24h reply-deadline counts
technicalDescription: InboundEmails grouped by handlingState and owning bookkeeper (component 04). openCount counts mails still open (handlingState לא טופל or ממתין, or empty on rows from before handling states; לא רלוונטי excluded); overdue = past dueAt, dueSoon = dueAt within 2 hours. טופל rows are never counted as open. dueAt is set at ingest from replySlaHours (24).

select.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.handlingState, 'לא טופל') <> 'טופל' AND COALESCE(e.category, '') <> 'לא רלוונטי' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.handlingState, 'לא טופל') <> 'טופל' AND COALESCE(e.category, '') <> 'לא רלוונטי' AND e.dueAt < NOW() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
SUM(CASE WHEN COALESCE(e.handlingState, 'לא טופל') <> 'טופל' AND COALESCE(e.category, '') <> 'לא רלוונטי' AND e.dueAt >= NOW() AND e.dueAt < NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)

calculatedColumns.name: overdueCount
calculatedColumns.description: Open and past the reply deadline
